newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Clondalkin says well placed for future.
newsitem.headline: Clondalkin says well placed for future.

text.p: Irish-based print and packaging company Clondalkin Group Plc said on Tuesday that it was well placed to make further advances in the future.
The company said in a results statement its present high levels of investments and the sound plans on which they are based, augured well for a continuation of this trend into the future.
"With good geographic balance, skilled employees, modern factories and motivated management, we are well placed to make further advances," Clondalkin said in a results statement.
